# The Helix and Gallery demos drop their GitHub stars button

## Context

The operator, on 22 Nov, looking at the Helix frame: "the github stars button could get removed at this point. however, the delta counter must absolutely stay. whole point of the demo". Then: "same for the gallery demo."

## The Problem

`examples/component/helix` and `examples/component/gallery` each pin a GitHub "Star" button to the stage's top right corner. A `showGitHubStarButton` config loads `https://buttons.github.io/buttons.js` into the page for it. It is promotion inside a demo, beside the DeltaUpdates counter, which is the demo's point.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/component/helix/Viewport.mjs` carries the button and its supporting code:
  - the `github-button` item;
  - `showGitHubStarButton_` and `afterSetShowGitHubStarButton`;
  - the `buttons.js` loader in `afterSetMounted`, which keeps `static windowIds` only for that;
  - a class doc line about it.
- The counter item sits at `right: 150px` to clear the button. `afterSetMounted` also turns on `renderCountDeltas`, which feeds the counter.
- `examples/component/gallery/MainContainer.mjs` repeats the button item, a `showGitHubStarButton` config, and a `buttons.js` loader on `mounted`. It has the same counter.
- `examples/component/coronaHelix` extends the Helix viewport, and `coronaGallery` has no button. No spec or capture recipe references the button.
- Design authority: the operator's words above.

## The Fix

Remove the button, its config, its hook, the `buttons.js` loading and the `windowIds` bookkeeping from both files. Keep the DeltaUpdates counters and `renderCountDeltas`, and move each counter into the corner the button leaves.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Neither demo, nor `coronaHelix`, shows a Star button or requests `buttons.github.io`.
- [ ] Both DeltaUpdates counters stay, still updating, in the top right corner.
- [ ] No console error in either demo. Before and after frames on the pull request.

## Out of Scope

The Covid app's header buttons and the big-data grid's star button (#6413). The operator named these two demos.

## Related

#21140, the examples work. #21454, the gallery and helix renewal (closed).
